question:
Karanta halin da ke gaba:
A jigon Tarihi na Farko na Ajin Hudu, wata malama ta tambayi dalibanta su kwatanta wayewar Maya, Aztec, da Inca kuma su nuna abubuwa uku masu kama a tsakaninsu. Daya daga cikin amsoshin da ta duba ya ce kamar haka:
“Dukansu manoma ne, kuma duk da cewa suna da ajizai na zamantakewa bayyanannu, dukansu talakawa ne saboda ba su da fasaha kamar mu kuma suna zaune a gidajen dutse masu sanyi sosai.”
Wane kuskure ne ya bayyana a cikin amsar dalibin?
answer_a: Ba ya amincewa da ƙimar asali ta wayoyin Amurka
answer_b: Yin hukunce-hukuncen zamani game da wayewar Amurka
answer_c: Bilikta al'adun da wayewar Amurka ta gada ga al'adar yanzu
answer_d: Rikita halayen wata wayewar Amurka da na wata dabam

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: Bayan Malam ya yi wa ɗalibai bayani kan muhimmancin ƙwaƙwalwa a rayuwar mutane, Malamin ya saita manufar koyo na tsara abubuwan da suka haɗa da ƙwaƙwalwa. Domin cimma wannan manufa, an gabatar da aikin bincike kan batun, wanda za a gudanar a cikin darasin sa'o'i biyu, biyu-biyu, a ɗakin kwamfuta. Aikin aji: 1. Gano waɗanne ne abubuwan da suka haɗa da ƙwaƙwalwa waɗanda ke shiga cikin tsarin haddace abu. 2. Ƙirƙiri tsarin hoto (diagram) wanda aka tsara waɗannan abubuwa bisa ga dangantakarsu a cikin tsarin, tare da bambance kowane ɗayansu a sarari. 3. Haɗa zanenka da bayani, gajere gwargwadon hali, don bayyana yadda aka gina ƙwaƙwalwa. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ne ya bayyana daidai ma'aunin tantancewa wanda ya dace da aikin da Malamin ya gabatar?
answer_a: Dalibai sun bambanta kuma sun bayyana ɓangarorin ƙwaƙwalwa
answer_b: Dalibai suna banbanta sassan ƙwaƙwalwa, kuma suna kimanta alaƙarsu ta juna
answer_c: Dalibai suna bambance sassan ƙwaƙwalwa kuma suna nazarin alaƙar da ke tsakaninsu
answer_d: Dalibai suna banbanta ɓangarorin ƙwaƙwalwa kuma suna bayyana kowannensu

question:
Karanta wannan yanayi mai zuwa:
A farkon wani sashin darasi, wani malami ya bayyana manufar saba da yanayi ta hanyar ma'ana. A cikin wannan yanayin, wani ɗalibi ya nemi ƙarin bayani ta hanyar misali.
Wanne daga cikin waɗannan maganganu ne ya dace ya zama misali don bayyana manufar saba da yanayi?
answer_a: Idan muka ci gaba da sa kankara a hannunmu, zai yi sanda, kuma ba za mu ji sanyin kankarar ba
answer_b: Mukan saya shamfu iri ɗaya saboda mun saba da shi
answer_c: Ta hanyar yin ƙarya akai-akai, muna haifar da rashin yarda a wajen wasu
answer_d: Idan mota da aka ajiye a titi ta kada ƙararrawa kowane dare da ƙarfe biyu na dare, a wani lokaci za mu daina damuwa da ita

question: Karanta yanayi mai zuwa: Farfesa Estefanía tana aiki a kan ka'idojin Pavlov da Skinner. Wani ɗalibi ya ambata cewa ya riga ya san su saboda ya gan su a cikin fim ɗin *A Clockwork Orange*. Ɗalibin ya ambaci lokacin da aka sanya babban jarumin ya kalli hotunan tashin hankali a fili a kai a kai yayin da ake masa allurar wani abu da ke haifar da rashin jin daɗi na jiki domin a gyara halayensa. Ta gaya masa cewa ya yi gaskiya wajen danganta wannan yanayin da ka'idojin da aka yi nazari a kansu. Na gaba, farfesar ta yi tambaya mai zuwa: Da wace ka'idar halayya kake danganta yanayin da ka bayyana? Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ya wakilci amsar ɗalibin da ta dace?
answer_a: Ina ganin horo ne na aiki domin maimaita al'amuran tashin hankali ƙarfafawa ce mara kyau wadda zata taimaka wajen kawar da halayen tashin hankali na jarumin
answer_b: Ina ganin classical conditioning ne saboda kallon fina-finan tashin hankali yana haifar da ƙarshen halayen tashin hankali na jarumin kuma wannan martani ne da aka koyar (conditioned response)
answer_c: A cikin yanayin nan, na ga koyarwar gargajiya domin an danganta zaman kallon fina-finai masu tashin hankali da rashin jin daɗin jikin babban jarumin domin ya samu gyara
answer_d: A cikin fage, ka’idoji biyun suna nan saboda an haɗa hotunan tashin hankali da rashin jin daɗin jiki. Wannan ya zama hukunci don kawo ƙarshen halayyar tashin hankali ta jarumin.

question: Malama ta gabatar da ma’anar motsin rai kuma ta nuna cewa motsin zuciya suna da tsanani, amma tsawon lokacinsu ya yi daidai da abin da ya motsa su. Bayan haka, ta nemi ɗalibai su yi jerin sunayen motsin rai. Wani ɗalibi ya ba da shawarar cewa, bisa ga abin da malamar ta bayyana, soyayya tana ɗaya daga cikin motsin rai da ya kamata a saka a jerin. Wane bayani ne daga malamar ya gyara shawarar ɗalibin?
answer_a: Soyayya wata ji ce mai tsanani, har abin da ke kawo ta kullum yana nan
answer_b: Yanayin kasancewa cikin soyayya koyaushe yana buƙatar kasancewar dalilin da ya haifar da shi, don haka shi ma motsin zuciya ne
answer_c: Halìn soyayya ba kamar motsin rai ba ne, saboda baya buƙatar abin da ke jawo shi
answer_d: Soyayya ba ta buƙatar kasancewar abin da ke motsa ta, don haka ba lallai ba ne a ɗauke ta a matsayin motsin rai

question: Karanta yanayin da ke gaba: Wata malama ta yi wa ɗalibanta bayani game da bambanci tsakanin tarbiyyar farko da tarbiyyar ta biyu. Bayan ta yi musu tambayoyi game da waɗannan ra'ayoyin, sai ta gano cewa ɗaliban ba su fahimce su yadda ya kamata ba. Wanne ne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba zai zama aikin da ya dace don sauƙaƙa fahimtar dukkanin ra'ayoyin biyu?
answer_a: A aji na gaba, ta bukaci ɗaliban su yi jerin abubuwan da suka koya daga iyalansu kafin su shiga makarantar yara kanana da kuma wani jerin abubuwan da suka koya a makarantar yara kanana, makaranta ko wasu da'irori da suka kasance a ciki a tsawon rayuwarsu. Sannan ta tattauna kuma ta yi nazarin waɗannan jerin abubuwan tare da su.
answer_b: A darasi na gaba, ta ce su yi jerin abubuwan koyo da suka tuna sun samu a cikin shekaru biyar na farkon yarinta da kuma wani jerin na abubuwan koyon da suke tare da su tun lokacin haihuwa. Daga nan, sai su tattauna tare, su yi nazari, kuma su fitar da manyan ra’ayoyin.
answer_c: A aji na gaba, ta tambayi ɗaliban su yi jerin bambance-bambance tsakanin girma a matsayin ɗa guda da girma tare da ƙarin 'yan'uwa. Sa'an nan ta tattauna kuma ta nazarta wannan jerin tare da su.
answer_d: A darasi na gaba, ta umurci ɗalibai su bayyana inda suka fito kuma su bambanta tsakanin rayuwa a ƙauye da ta a birni. Daga nan kuma, tare za su tattauna bayanan nasu kuma su fitar da manyan ra'ayoyi domin su gina waɗannan manufofi tare da haɗin gwiwa

question: Malami yana aiki kan batutuwan muhawara da ɗalibansa na zaɓi kuma ya gabatar musu da wannan batu: Batu na 1: Wasu masoya suna da kyawawan halaye, Batu na 2: Wasu masu kyawawan halaye maza ne nagari. Wace tambaya malam ya kamata ya yi wa ɗaliban don su warware batun muhawarar daidai?
answer_a: Shin sigalojizim yana da kalmomi uku?
answer_b: Menene faɗin kalmar tsakiya a cikin hujojin?
answer_c: Shin akwai wata saɓani tsakanin sharuɗɗan da ke cikin matakan farko?
answer_d: Shin akwai aƙalla asali na duniya ɗaya?

question: Karanta tsarin tunani mai zuwa wanda dalibin shekarar ƙarshe ta sakandare ya shirya: Manufar makarantar sakandare ita ce kamala. Shekarar ƙarshe ita ce manufar makarantar sakandare. Shekarar ƙarshe ita ce kamala. Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka masu zuwa ke nuna kuskuren da dalibin ya yi?
answer_a: Syllogism ɗin yana da fiye da kalmomi uku
answer_b: Babban fage ya ƙunshi ƙaramin fage a cikin ma'anarsa ta hankali
answer_c: Girman Farilla ta farko ya fi na Farilla ta biyu
answer_d: Ɗaya daga cikin hujjojin keɓaɓɓiya ce, saboda haka matuƙar ba za ta zama dunƙulalliya ba

question: A cikin azuzuwan darasi na "Tushen Ɗabi'a," malamin yana tattauna ra'ayin halin ɗan Adam a wajen Hobbes da Rousseau. Wani dalibi ya ce ana ƙaddara nagarta ko muguntar ɗan Adam ne ta mutanen da ke kewaye da shi. Wane bayani malamin zai iya bayarwa don gyara wannan kuskuren?
answer_a: Yanayin dabi'a yanayi ne da ake tsammani don sukar gina Jiha dangane da yanayin ɗan adam
answer_b: A Yanayin Halitta, wajibi ne a sami mutane nagari da miyagu don a sami yarjejeniya
answer_c: Halayen kirki ko miyagu na mutane yanayi ne masu muhimmanci waɗanda ke gaba da aiwatar da yarjejeniyar zamantakewa
answer_d: Yanayin halitta wani yanayi ne na hasashe don bayyana yadda nagarta ko mugunta ke tantance irin gwamnatin da ke tasowa.

question: Karanta lamarin da ke biyo baya: Wata malama ta tambayi ɗalibanta su danganta fahimtar haƙiƙa a cikin Plato da Aristotle ta hanyar ra'ayoyi ko ma'anoni. Wace kwatanci da ɗaliban suka gabatar ce ta nuna bambancin da ke tsakanin waɗannan marubuta a sarari?
answer_a: Rai da mutuwa
answer_b: Duniya da Aljannar Kirista
answer_c: Gaskiya da ƙarya
answer_d: Sihiri da kimiyya

question: A lokacin karatun rubutun *Essay Concerning Human Understanding* na John Locke, malamin ya gabatar da niyyar zurfafa bincike kan ra'ayin siffofin ji (sensitive qualities) na ka’idar ilimi, don sauƙaƙe fahimtar sa da kuma ƙarfafa wannan ilimin. Wacece a cikin dabarun da ke biye za ta dace don haɗa shi da wasu ra'ayoyin da aka riga aka gani a cikin darasin kuma ta baiwa ɗalibi damar fahimtar wannan abun ciki?
answer_a: Ka gayyaci dalibi ya sake duba ƙwaƙwalwar azanci (sensory memory) a matsayin wani ɓangare na sarrafa ilimi (cognitive processes) kuma ya danganta wannan ga hujjojin Locke (Locke's postulates), yana kwatanta ainihin ra'ayoyin duka shawarwarin.
answer_b: Ka shawarta ɗalibin ya kwatanta tunanin Locke da tunane-tunane da suka shigo cikin tunanin Descartes (adventitious ideas) ta hanyar amfani da taswirar ma'ana (concept map)
answer_c: Umurci dalibin ya yi nazari a kan ma'anonin tsinkaya da fahimta daga Ilimin halayyar ɗan adam na fahimta (cognitive Psychology) kuma ya kwatanta su da ma'anar Locke, ta hanyar kafa kamanceceniya, bambance-bambance, da tambayoyi
answer_d: Ka nuna wa ɗalibin ya kafa kwatanci tsakanin ra'ayin Aristotle na asali (essence) game da gina ilimi da ra'ayin Locke wanda ya dogara kan bambance-bambancen tushe (elemental distinctions) na kowace hujja (postulate)

question: Karanta wannan shari’ar: Wani malami ya gabatar da wasu ra’ayoyin Jean Paul Sartre game da ‘yancin ɗan adam. Wata ɗaliba ta shiga tsakani don nuna cewa tana ganin yana da wahala a fahimci ra’ayin marubucin cewa babu asalin halittar ɗan adam. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan amsoshin malamin zai iya taimaka wa ɗalibar ta fahimci ra’ayin Sartre?
answer_a: Ba kamar mutane ba, abubuwan da wani ya tsara, misali maƙeri, ba za su iya samun ainihi ba kafin wanzuwar da ake ba su a lokacin da ake ƙera su.
answer_b: Kamar yadda yake ga mutane, abubuwan da wani ya tsara, mai sana’a misali, suna iya samun haƙiƙa da aka riga aka ƙayyade, amma duk da haka, saboda wannan dole ne su wanzu kuma
answer_c: Mu mutane ba wani ne ya tsara mu ba, saboda haka babu wani asali ko ɗabi’ar ɗan Adam da ke gaba da aiwatarwa da kuma fahimtar ‘yancinmu na aiki
answer_d: An tsara mutane ne ta wani wanda ya ba mu damar yin aiki (zabi mai 'yanci); saboda haka, mu ne kawai muke ƙayyade abin da muke bisa ga ayyukanmu.

question:
Yi la’akari da yanayin da ke gaba:
A wani ajin 'Asali na Da’a', malamar ta yi bayanin ra’ayin tsananin damuwa (anguish) a cewar Jean Paul Sartre. Lokacin da take neman misali na ra’ayin daga ɗalibanta, ɗaya daga cikinsu ya amsa cewa: "Tsananin damuwa shi ne lokacin da mutum ya shiga baƙin ciki saboda rashin sa’a a soyayya."
Mene ne ainihin kuskuren da ke tattare da misalin da ɗalibin ya bayar?
answer_a: Kuskure ne a danganta ƙuncin wanzuwa da matakai na ruhi da zamantakewa, domin alaƙa da wasu tana duka biyu tana sauƙaƙawa kuma tana hana tabbatar da kai a matsayin wani aiki
answer_b: Bai dace ba a takaita damuwar wanzuwa zuwa wata lalura ta tunani; wannan fassarar tana ware sanin kai a matsayin wani al'amari na wanzuwa
answer_c: Gaggaruwa ce a haɗa ra'ayin kunci na rayuwa da yanayin motsin zuciya, domin hakan bai fahimci dangantakar kunci da sanin hakkin ɗaukar nauyi ba.
answer_d: Kuskure ne a danganta baƙin ciki na rayuwa (existential anguish) da alamomin damuwa (depression), tunda gazawar soyayya na iya zama turjiya ga 'yancin kai na mutum

question: Karanta lamarin da ke gaba: Malami ya yi bayanin ka'idar Nietzsche game da asalin ɗabi'a, wadda aka kwatanta a cikin 'On the Genealogy of Morality'. Wani ɗalibi ya bayyana cewa yana goyon bayan ra'ayoyin marubucin saboda yana kare ɗabi'ar masu ƙarfi, wadda take adawa da ta masu raunin hali. A cikin zaɓuɓɓuka na gaba, a wanne ne aka yi bayanin kuskuren da ke ɓoye a cikin bayanin ɗalibin?
answer_a: Ɗalibin yana danganta ɗabi'ar masu mulki da 'yancin yin aiki, yana barin sakamakon ɗabi'a na ayyukan
answer_b: Ɗalibin yana zato cewa ɗabi'ar nihilism dole ne marasa ƙarfi su shawo kanta don isa ga Mafi-mutum
answer_c: Dalibi ya rikita sake tantance ɗabi'ar masu rauni da bayyanar wasu halayen mutum
answer_d: Dalibin ya rikita sauyin ƙimar dabi'u da bayyanar ƙarfin hali

question: Karanta yanayin da ke biyo baya: A cikin mahallin darasin nan mai taken "Manyan wayewar zamanin kafin zuwan Columbus", malami, yayin da yake bayyana manyan halaye na tsarin tattalin arzikin Incas, ya lura cewa wasu ɗalibansa ba su fahimci kalmar "tattalin arzikin sake rabawa" ba. Sai ya yanke shawarar sake bayyana manufar, amma a wannan karon ta hanyar misali. Wanne daga cikin misalan da ke biyo baya ya fi dacewa da manufar tattalin arzikin sake rabawa?
answer_a: Ƙaramar hukumar ta mayar wa tsofaffin mazaunanta kuɗin da suka biya bara don kwasar shara
answer_b: Telethon ɗin ya ƙaddamar da sabon gangami don tara kuɗi fiye da na bara, kuma da su a gina sabon cibiyar gyara hali
answer_c: ONEMI ta karkatar da albarkatun da Jiha ta ware domin tunkarar bala'in da kuma sake gina yankin da ambaliyar ta shafa
answer_d: Tushen Hogar de Cristo ya rage kudin gidajen zaman su na jin kai

question: A lokacin raka'ar "Tasirin tsarin mamayewa," wani malami na aji biyar yana so ya tantance ko ɗalibansa sun fahimci tasirin mamayewar a kan ƴan asalin Amurka. Don yin hakan, ya tsara wani kayan aikin tantance fahimtarsu. Wace manuniya ta nasara daga cikin waɗanda malamin ya samar ce ta dace da manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Nemo a taswira al'ummomin 'yan asali waɗanda Spaniyawa suka ci galaba a kansu
answer_b: Kammala, bisa ga teburorin kididdiga, menene tsarin zamantakewa ya kasance a lokacin cin nasara
answer_c: Yi la'akari da abubuwan da suka jawo raguwar yawan jama'a daga cikin tarihai
answer_d: Ku gano, bisa ga majiyoyin zane-zanen gumaka, halayen fafatawar da ke tsakanin 'yan asali da masu nasara

question:
A karanta rubutu na gaba:
[...]Wata rukuni na yara suna karanta wani rubutu mai bayani game da wata ƙabila ta asali (Diaguita) waɗanda ke aikin tukwane. Rubutun yana tare da hoto da ke nuna mata suna niƙa hatsi a turmi, da kuma tukwanen yumbu a gefensu.

Malamar ta matso kusa da rukuni, sai ɗaya daga cikin yaran ya ce:
-“Waɗannan 'yan asalin sun yi sana'ar tukwane.” “Mene ne suka yi da waɗannan kayan aikin?” Malama ta tambaya.
-“Don ƙawata gidaje,” yaron ya tabbatar.
-Malamar ta kalli hoton kuma ta sake matsawa: “Me ya sa kake ganin sun yi amfani da waɗannan abubuwan don ƙawatawa?”
-“Shi ya sa mahaifiyata take sayen su.”
-Sai wani yaron ya ƙara da cewa: “Haka ne, mahaifiyata ma tana son sana’o’in hannu. Muna da su da yawa a gida.” [..]
Aisenberg, Beatriz (gyarawa)
Waɗanne rikice-rikice a fahimtar lokacin tarihi ne suka bayyana a cikin halin da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Tushen wahalar ganewa a cikin abubuwan yau da kullum dabi'ar tushen tarihi
answer_b: Zuciyar danganta ma'ana ga abubuwa da yanayi daga abubuwan ishara na zamani
answer_c: Kimanun wahalar da ke tattare da kiyaye tsaka-tsaki a kan zubin fasaha a matsayin tushen kayan aiki
answer_d: Sha'awar yin game-gamen gaban yanayin da ke gabatar da abubuwan da ke nuna ci gaba

question: A lokacin raka'ar "Tsarin 'Yancin Kai na Ƙasa," malamin ya nanata wa dalibansa na aji na takwas iya yin aiki da ma'ajin bayanai, domin su iya banbance fagen da ke bayyana ci gaban wannan tsari. Wanne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa zai ba da damar cimma manufar da aka sanya wa ajin?
answer_a: Zana daga Tsarin Mulkin Spain na 1812, menene canje-canjen da suka biyo bayan 'yantar da Sarki Ferdinand VII
answer_b: Koyi ra'ayoyin Creoles game da kafa Babban Junta na Cádiz
answer_c: Gano a cikin tarihin rayuwar shugabannin 'yancin kai, matakan da suka tsara tsarin (ko: matakan da suka gina tsarin)
answer_d: Shirya a cikin jawaban Juntar Gwamnatin Ƙasa ta Farko, ka'idojin siyasa da suka goyi bayan matakin.

question: Dalibai na aji takwas sun yi wannan tambaya kan batun "Juyin Juya Halin Masana'antu": Me ya sa ake kiran batun Juyin Juya Halin Masana'antu alhali ba mu ga wani yaki ko bore da zai tabbatar da sunan ba? Don fadada fahimtar takaitaccen tsarin tarihi da dalibin yake da shi, wane irin la’akari ya kamata sabon tsari kan wannan ra'ayi ya yi?
answer_a: Bayyana masana'antu daga mahanga mai dalilai-masu-yawa
answer_b: Ku zurfafa yanayin masana'antu a matsayin jerin abubuwan da ke da alaƙa da juna tare da nasu kuzarin (dynamic)
answer_c: Bayyana sarai mahallin lokaci da Juyin Juya Halin Masana'antu ya samo asali a cikinsa
answer_d: Ƙarfafa nazarin bincike mai zurfi na kafofin game da yanayin ma'aikatan masana'antu

question: Wani malami yana aiki da ɗalibansa na aji na 6 a kan manufa ta koyo kamar haka: don bayyana yankunan siyasa-mulki na ƙasar ta fuskar yanki. Saboda haka, ya yanke shawarar haɗa batun da labarai masu zuwa game da ƙirƙirar yankin Ñuble kuma ya gudanar da bincike kan tushen labarin: Majalisar Dattijai ta amince da ƙirƙirar Yanki na Sha Shida (XVI) na Ñuble. Wannan matakin, wanda yanzu yake shirye don sanarwa a hukumance, zai kuma ƙirƙiri sabbin larduna guda uku. Ƙasar Chile za ta sami yankinta na sha shida. Haka Majalisar Dattijai ta yanke shawara a wannan Laraba bayan amincewa da ƙuri'u 26 na goyon baya, biyu na adawa, kuma babu waɗanda suka ƙi jefa ƙuri'a a cikin matakinta na uku na aikin da zai ƙirƙiri sabon Yankin Ñuble. Wannan matakin, wanda yanzu yake shirye don sanarwa a hukumance, zai kuma ƙirƙiri sabbin larduna guda uku: Diguillín (Chillán, Chillán Viejo, Quillón, Bulnes, San Ignacio, El Carmen, Pinto, Pemuco, da Yungay), Punilla (San Carlos, Ñiquén, Coihueco, San Fabián, da San Nicolás), da kuma Itata (Quirihue, Cobquecura, Ninhue, Treguaco, Coelemu, Portezuelo, da Ránquil). Wane irin bayani game da tsarin siyasa-mulki na ƙasar Chile ɗalibin zai iya cirowa daga labarin da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Sharuɗɗan fasaha don ƙirƙirar yanki
answer_b: Tsarin sararin samaniyar yankin a matsayin wata yanki ta ƙasa
answer_c: Manufofin da ke goyon bayan yankin yanki na ƙasa
answer_d: Matakan mulki na yanki a matsayin raka'ar ƙasa

question: Don yin aiki a kan manufar bayyana manyan akidun sassaucin ra'ayi da yadda ake amfani da shi a wata kasa misali a cikin karni na 19, malami a makarantar sakandare zai nemi a matsayin aikin farawa, a samar da ma'anar sassaucin ra'ayi. Da zarar ɗalibai sun raba aikin nasu, malamin zai ba da shawarar wani aiki na biyu da nufin ƙarfafa ra'ayin. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ne zai ba malamin damar bunkasa wannan mataki na biyu na koyo?
answer_a: Rubuta tarihin rayuwa na wani wakili na ra'ayin 'yanci a ƙasar misali a lokacin ƙarni na 19
answer_b: Ka gwada ra'ayin da ɗaliban suka shimfiɗa da manyan farillan ra'ayin 'yanci na wancan lokacin
answer_c: Ku samar da wani tsari na lokaci wanda zai sanya 'yancin kai a matsayin mahallin tarihi a cikin matakai daban-daban na bunkasarsa
answer_d: Binciki wata majiya ta tarihi domin gano akidun sassauci da ke cikinta

question: Da nufin bayyana manyan sauye-sauyen tattalin arziki a Chile bayan Babban Raɗaɗin Tattalin Arziki na jari-hujja, wani malama ta fara darasi ta hanyar tambayar ɗalibanta: "Yaya aka fuskanci rikicin na 1929 a Chile?" Dangane da amsoshinsu, ta lura cewa yawanci ra'ayin shi ne cewa tsarin masana'antu na maye gurbin kayan shigowa (ISI) shi ne mafita ga rikicin. Don haka, don canza wannan tunani na farko, ta raba musu rubutu mai zuwa domin su yi nazari: Dangane da alkaluman da Gabriel Palma ya bayar, duk da cewa zuwa 1935 sassan ma'adinai - musamman nitrate - ba su farfaɗo ba zuwa matakan 1929, samar da nitrate ya karu daga tan 694,000 a 1932 zuwa tan 1,200,000 a 1935; a lokaci guda, samar da tagulla mai tsafta da ta fitar ya karu da kashi 270%. Sabanin haka, duk da cewa noma ya riga ya farfaɗo da matakan samar da shi na 1929 a 1933, amma daga baya ya tsaya cak [...]. Idan a ƙarshen 1932 akwai ma'aikata 129,000 marasa aiki, adadin ya faɗi zuwa 69,000 a ƙarshen 1933, zuwa 28,000 a ƙarshen 1934, zuwa 8,000 bayan shekara guda, kuma zuwa ƙasa da 5,000 a 1936. Tarihin Chile na Karni na 20, Correa, S. Wane tunani na farko na ɗaliban malamar ke ƙoƙarin canza shi da nazarin rubutun da ya gabata?
answer_a: Wai farfaɗowar tattalin arziki ta fara ne da kafa CORFO
answer_b: Zaton cewa CORFO ta haɓaka tsarin sabuntawar harkar tagulla a Chile
answer_c: Domin fahimtar cewa manufar CORFO ita ce kawar da illoli a masana'antar nitrate
answer_d: Don yin imani cewa saboda ƙirƙirar CORFO jihar Chile ta kawo ƙarshen dogaro da tattalin arziki

question: Wane muhimmin ra'ayi na siyasa na farko ya kamata ɗaliban aji na biyu na makarantar sakandare su fahimta domin tattauna batun tsarin mulkin mallaka (totalitarian regimes)?
answer_a: Ikon zamantakewa na jama'a
answer_b: Koyarwar akidar siyasa
answer_c: Raba ikonin jiha
answer_d: ɗaukakar shugaban mai ban sha'awa

question: Malami yana tsara kimanta darasin 'Fitowar samfuran siyasa da tattalin arziki daban-daban a cikin karni na 20,' kuma ɗaya daga cikin manufofin koyo da za a auna shine a bambanta halayen tsarin mulkin kama-karya na Nazi da na Soviet. Domin wannan manufa, an tsara alamomin kimantawa kamar haka: 1.- Yana gano yanayin tarihi da mulkin kama-karya ya fito. 2.- Yana bambanta darajar da aka ba wa yanki. 3.- Yana gane amfani da farfaganda ta siyasa mai rudani (demagogic). 4.- Yana gane rawar da aka danganta wa al'umma a matsayin mai taka rawa a zamantakewa. Da wane rukuni na alamomi biyu za a iya kimanta manufar koyo da aka gabatar?
answer_a: ɗaya da biyu
answer_b: daya da uku
answer_c: biyu da hudu
answer_d: uku da huɗu

question: Malami yana shirin gudanar da kimantawa na ginshiƙi (formative assessment) tare da ɗaliban shekarar farko ta sakandare don auna cimma burin kimanta tasirin al'adu na duniya (globalization) daga abubuwan da suka gani na yau da kullum. Wacece daga cikin ayyukan kimantawa masu biyowa ya kamata ɗaliban su yi?
answer_a: Tattaunawa game da illolin da zamanantar da duniya ke yi a kan birnin da suke zaune a ciki
answer_b: Taro na tasowa da tunani don tsare lokacin tsarin duniya baki ɗaya
answer_c: Wasan kwaikwayo kan muhimmancin sabbin fasahohi a fannin sadarwa
answer_d: Tasiri na ɗaukar al'adu na waje ga danginsu a shekarun baya-bayan nan a cikin wani rubutu makala

question:
A farkon darasin 'Kalubale na Duniya ga Yankuna', wata malama ta yanke shawarar gabatar da waɗannan kanun labarai ga ɗalibanta don gano ko sun san wasu daga cikin ra'ayoyin da ke tattare da batun:
- Tagulla ta haura zuwa $2.71 kan kowace laba saboda haɓakar da ba a zata ba a China.
- Tallace-tallace a fannin kamun kifi a Chile sun karu da kashi 12% a farkon kwata saboda buƙatar Asiya.
- Masana'antar giyar inabi ta Chile ta sami yabo a duk faɗin duniya: Shin tana kan ganiyarta ne?
- Sashin gandun daji da samar da ayyukan yi. Sama da ayyuka dubu ɗari uku saboda ƙaruwar fitarwa.
Waɗanne ra'ayoyi ne daga cikin waɗannan ɗalibai ke buƙatar sani don fahimtar ma'anar kanun labaran?
answer_a: Almajirantarwa ta duniya
answer_b: Tsarin tattalin arziki
answer_c: Dorewar muhalli
answer_d: shakar tattalin arziki tsakanin juna

question: A cikin mahallin darasin 'Yin amfani da 'yancin zama ɗan ƙasa da tsarukan wakilcin siyasa', malamin aji na huɗu ya raba wannan tushe mai zuwa ga ɗalibansa kuma ya ba su ƴan mintuna su karanta shi ɗaiɗai: A shekara ta 2011, an kafa doka mai lamba 20500, wadda ta ba da damar samar da Majalisun Al’umma na Ƙungiyoyin Farar Hula (COSOC), waɗanda suke da halin ba da shawara kuma za su iya tallafawa wajen cimma manufar yin tasiri a cikin tsarawa, aiwatarwa, da tantance manufofin jama'a na al'umma, na yanki, da kuma gudanarwar kananan hukumomi. Dole ne waɗannan su hadu a kalla sau huɗu a shekara. [Ma'ajin Ƙarƙashin Sakatariyar Ci Gaban Yanki da Gudanarwa (Gyara)]. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan sakamakon koyo za a iya cimmawa da wannan tushe da aka bayar?
answer_a: Gano lokutan shigar da 'yan ƙasa ciki
answer_b: Bayyana ƙa'idar wakilcin siyasa
answer_c: Gane ayyukan ƙananan hukumomi
answer_d: Kwantar da hanyar raba iko ta siyasa-mulki (decentralization)

question: Karanta yanayin aji na gaba: Miss Pérez, malamar Turanci, ta fara sabon kashi na darasi. Ta rubuta "Hutu" a kan allon rubutu kuma ta liƙa hoton tallar yawon shakatawa. Ta nemi ɗalibanta su kalli taken darasin da hoton, su raba ra'ayoyi kan abin da darasin zai kunsa. Sa'an nan, ta nemi su gano nau'o'in hutu daban-daban da aka ambata a cikin tallar, kuma ta tanadi ƙarin ayyuka ga kowane nau'i. Don cike gurbi, malamar ta ba su kayan karatu game da sansanonin hutu na matasa a Amurka, tana tambayar su ko suna da irin wannan a ƙasarsu ta gida. Da zarar sun gama, ta ce za su saurari wata tattaunawa ta wani iyali da ke zaɓen inda za su yi hutunsu na gaba. Bayan haka, ta nemi su yi hasashen waɗanne kalmomi da yanayi da aka ambata a baya suke tunanin za su ji a cikin tattaunawar. A ƙarshe, Miss Pérez da ɗalibanta sun saurari tattaunawar kuma suka duba tunaninsu. Me malamar take yi a wannan yanayin aji da ya gabata?
answer_a: Tana gabatar da sassan batun/jigon karatu
answer_b: Tana gudanar da ayyukan baki a cikin aji don sa ɗalibai su yi tunani a kan maudu'in darasin naúrar
answer_c: Tana amfani da dabarun saurare domin sanin mahallin maudu'in rubutun da kuma zaburar da ɗalibai
answer_d: Tana amfani da ayyukan zahiri domin dalibai su danganta batun da rayuwarsu kuma su bayyana ra'ayoyinsu

question: Me ya sa samfurin duniya yake da amfani a matsayin kayan koyarwa?
answer_a: Saboda yana ba da damar lura da siffar Duniya a zahiri
answer_b: Saboda yana taimaka wajen gane daukakin bangarorin kwakwalwa a lokaci guda
answer_c: Saboda yana taimakawa wajen nazarin latitudin Duniya dalla-dalla
answer_d: Saboda yana baiwa damar gano kowane wuri a duniya daidai

question: Karanta yanayin da ke biyo baya: Wani malamin firamare na aji na biyu ya nuna wa ɗalibansa taswirar yankunan Arewacin, Tsakiyar, da Kudancin ƙasar Chile. Sannan, ya nuna musu hotunan yanayin ƙasa na waɗannan yankuna kuma ya ce su zana da'ira da ja a kan hotunan yankin arewa; da kore, waɗanda ke tsakiya; da kuma baƙi, waɗanda ke kudu. Wanne ne daga cikin manufofin nan masu zuwa aikin da aka yi a baya ya fi dacewa da shi?
answer_a: Rarraba shimfidar wurare bisa ga yanki na labarin ƙasa
answer_b: Kwatanta yankuna na gografiya bisa ga siffofin ƙasarsu
answer_c: Gano halaye na yankunan kasa
answer_d: Gano wurare bisa ga yankin ƙasa

question: Karanta halin da ke gaba: Wata malama tana shirya ayyuka da aka yi niyya don bai wa ɗalibai damar bayyana dangantakar da ke tsakanin Mapuche da Mutanen Sifaniya a lokacin mulkin mallaka. Don cimma wannan, ta tsara wani aiki na farko bisa ga rubutu mai zuwa: A cikin majalisar da aka gudanar a Paicaví a 1605, an kafa cewa mutanen kan iyaka dole ne su biya matsakaicin haraji a cikin kayayyaki, yayin da aka hana hidimar kai. Idan sun ba da mutane don yin aiki a gonakin Mutanen Sifaniya, za a biya su da azurfa ko makamancinta. Bugu da ƙari, dole ne su tafi yaƙi da abokan gaban Sarki. Indiyawa sun amsa da gamsuwa cewa za su kasance cikin salama, saboda Mai Martaba Sarki ya magance cikakkiyar dalilin tawayensu da maganinsa, wanda shine hidimar kai wacce suka yi tawaye saboda ita. An lura, to, cewa a waɗannan shekarun Indiyawan abokai har yanzu suna fitowa daga yankin Indiyawan encomienda. Sun fara, duk da haka, bayyana matsayinsu na musamman -dangane da ƙarni na baya-, tunda ba sa ƙara zama Indiyawa masu zuwa yaƙi tare da encomenderos ɗinsu daga yankin tsakiya na ƙasar, amma Indiyawan encomienda ne daga yankin rikicin ɗaya. A wani ɓangaren, an yi ƙoƙarin rage musu wahala ta hanyar hana hidimar kai, wanda shine babban dalilin rashin gamsuwarsu. Indiyawan abokai a kan iyakar Araucanian, (Andrea Ruiz-Esquide). Dangane da rubutun da ke sama, wane aiki ne zai tantance idan ɗalibai sun gano dangantaka tsakanin Mapuche da Mutanen Sifaniya a lokacin mulkin mallaka?
answer_a: Suna yin fosta da ke taƙaita manufar yarjejeniyar Paicaví
answer_b: Suna taƙaitawa daga wani zane-zane muhimman yarjejeniyoyin da ke tsakanin Mapuche da Mutanen Spain
answer_c: Suna auna dukkan nau'o'in hulɗa tsakanin Mutanen Spain da Mapuche kuma suna ƙirƙira wata katin jigo don kowane ɗaya daga cikinsu
answer_d: Sun gano majalisar Paicaví kuma sun bayyana yadda iyakar da ke tsakanin ƙungiyoyin biyu ta canza a tsawon lokaci

question:
Karanta yanayi mai zuwa:
A ƙarshen sashin karatu na “Gadon Athens,” ɗaya daga cikin manufofin da malamin ya ke so ya tantance shine fahimtar manyan siffofin dimokuraɗiyyar Athens, kuma don duba matakin nasarar, ya nemi ɗalibansa su tsara ginshiƙi na kwatanci tsakanin dimokuraɗiyyar Athens da dimokuraɗiyyar ƙasar Chile ta yanzu. Don tantance amsoshin, ya shirya jagora bisa ga abubuwan da ke da ci gaba a tarihi da kuma waɗanda ba su da shi.
Wanne daga cikin alamomin tantancewa masu zuwa ne ke nuna amincewa da wani abu na canji tsakanin dimokuraɗiyyun nan biyu?
answer_a: Gano kasancewar tsarin iko na hukumomi
answer_b: Gane bambancin ayyukan gwamnati
answer_c: Gano matakin shiga cikin yanke shawarar gwamnati
answer_d: Yana amincewa da haƙƙin zama ɗan ƙasa bisa ga cika sharaɗi

question: Malamin Falsafa yana shirin gudanar da aji a kan ma'anar yanayin dabi'a daga ra'ayoyin J. Locke, T. Hobbes, da J.J. Rousseau, kuma manufar wannan shiri ita ce: "Don gwada waɗannan ka'idoji da halayen mutum na dabi'a (mai 'yanci, mai hankali, da mai son zama da jama'a)." Wace daga cikin ayyukan da malamin ya gabatar za ta ba wa ɗalibansa damar cimma manufar wannan aji?
answer_a: Ɗalibai suna binciken manufar yanayin halitta a kowane marubuci, sannan su kai wa malami rahoton abin da suka gano.
answer_b: Dalibai suna nazarin dangantakar Hauwa’i ta Ingila da Yanayin Halitta bisa ga fahimtar ɗan Adam
answer_c: Dalibai suna tattara bayanai a kan dabi'un halittar ɗan Adam, kuma suna rubuta su a littattafansu
answer_d: Daliban sun karanta wata takarda game da ra'ayoyin kowane marubuci a kan yanayin dabi'a, kuma suka gano bambance-bambancensu da kamance-kamancensu.

question: Malami yana aiki tare da ɗaliban shekarar ƙarshe na sakandire a kan tsarin siyasa na J. J. Rousseau, tare da mai da hankali musamman a kan ra'ayin nufin gaba ɗaya, wanda masanin falsafar Faransa ya yi amfani da shi a cikin littafinsa The Social Contract (Yarjejeniyar Jama'a) (1762). Wanne ne a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba ke wakiltar misali mai dacewa don kwatanta ra'ayin nufin gaba ɗaya ga waɗannan ɗalibai?
answer_a: Zabɓin rinjaye mai sauƙi don yanke shawarar shugabancin ajin
answer_b: Halartar dukkanin ɗaliban makarantar da ma'aikatan koyarwa don cimma yarjejeniya
answer_c: Neman ƙarin taimakon karatu don ajin, duk da cewa akwai ɗaliban da ba sa bukatarsa
answer_d: Tattaunawa tsakanin ɗalibai masu ra'ayoyi daban-daban don cimma matsaya a cikin ajin makaranta

question: Karanta lamarin da ke gaba: A cikin aji game da Falsafar Ra'ayoyin Plato, Farfesa ya yi bayanin manyan halayen ra'ayoyin Platonic, daga cikinsu ya nuna cewa 'kowane ra'ayi guda ɗaya ne, kasancewar shi wakilcin abin da yake jigo ga rukuni na abubuwa'. Wani ɗalibi, da yake ruduwa da wannan magana, ya amsa cewa hakan ba zai yiwu ba kuma ya ba da misali cewa mutane biyu suna tunanin ra'ayi ɗaya, wani yanayi da ya saɓa wa zato na guda ɗaya na ra'ayin. Idan aka yi la'akari da Falsafar Ra'ayoyin Plato, wace zaɓi ce ta bayyana ma'anar da ke tattare da kuskuren ɗalibin?
answer_a: Ɗalibi yana tsammani cewa ra'ayoyi suke fitowa daga tattaunawa
answer_b: Dalibi ya gane cewa tunani haƙiƙa ne na basira
answer_c: Dalibi yana ganin cewa ra'ayoyi suna da dangantaka
answer_d: Dalibi yana tunani cewa ra'ayoyi wani ɓangare ne na Duniya mai hankali.

question: A cikin wani aji na babbar makarantar sakandare game da Tarihin Falsafa, wata malama da ɗalibanta suna nazarin muhimman ra'ayoyin falsafa na R. Descartes. Wanne daga cikin waɗannan maganganun ya yi daidai da wata wahala da ɗalibai za su iya fuskanta, dangane da fahimtar furucin cewa “Ina tunani, don haka ina wanzuwa”?
answer_a: Yanke wanzuwar tunanin Descartes
answer_b: Haɗa wanzuwa da yin amfani da shakka mai bin tsari
answer_c: Tilasta tunanin wanzuwa yana ƙarƙashin aikin tunani na cogito
answer_d: Danganta wanzuwar res cogitans da wanzuwar res extensa

question: Malami yana yi wa ɗalibansa na ajin uku na sakandare bayanin tsarin ilimin azanci. Wane daga cikin waɗannan manufofi ne ɗalibai suke buƙatar su riga sun yi maganarsu a baya don su fahimci ra'ayin fahimta?
answer_a: Kwarewa
answer_b: Jin
answer_c: Gaskiya
answer_d: Hankali

question: A sashin Makarantar Tsakiya: Halayyar Siyasa, Malamin zai yi aiki a kan kalaman da T. Hobbes ya yaɗa: "homo homini lupus". Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan ra’ayoyi ne ya kamata ɗalibai su riga sun sani don fahimtar maganar da aka yi?
answer_a: Doka ta yi rinjaye
answer_b: Kwantiragin zamantakewa
answer_c: Dukiya ta kashin kai (ko: Mulki na kashin kai)
answer_d: Yanayin halitta

question: Wani malamin makarantar sakandare yana shirya darasi kan ka’idar Kant game da yiwuwar ilimi; don yin haka, dole ne ya tantance ilimin gabanin da yake wajibi domin ɗalibansa su iya magance irin wannan ka’idar yadda ya kamata. Wane ilimin gabanin ne malamin ya kamata ya gane a cikin ɗalibansa domin su iya tunkarar wannan ka’idar?
answer_a: Ku gane ra'ayoyin D. Hume da J. Locke a matsayin tushen ka'idojin da suka gabaci shawarar I. Kant
answer_b: Fahimci ra'ayin Ingilishi na dogmatism da empiricism a matsayin rafi da suka gabaci shawarar Kant
answer_c: Bincika ra'ayoyin lokaci da sarari a matsayin tsare-tsaren tunani da suka zama dole don sani, a cewar I. Kant
answer_d: Fahimci ma'anonin abu mai bayyana (phenomenon) da kuma abu na asali (noumenon) a matsayin bayanai irin na Kant game da abin da za a iya sani

question: A karkashin tsarin kimantawa dangane da manyan ra'ayoyin Plato, malamin Falsafa yana nufin tantance wannan manufa: "Fahimtar ka'idar shigar kasancewa (na halitta) a falsafar Plato." Wane alamar kimantawa ce ta yi daidai da wannan manufa da aka ambata?
answer_a: Bambanta tsakanin manufofin episteme da doxa
answer_b: Shirya ra'ayoyin Plato bisa ga darajojin kamala
answer_c: Gano nau'ukan rai guda uku a tatsuniyar keken dawakai
answer_d: Bambance tsakanin ra'ayoyin duniya mai-ganuwa da kuma duniya mai-fahimtawa (ko mai-hankaltuwa)

question: Malami yana karantawa a aji tare da dalibansa tunanin falsafar zati guda biyu na farko na R. Descartes da nufin aiki kan manufar koyo mai zuwa: 'Sanin da nazarin ra'ayin hankali na zamani na R. Descartes.' Wanne ne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa da daliban suka yi zai samar da shaida na cimma manufar?
answer_a: Suna bayyana hujjojin hankali da aka gabatar a cikin zuzzurfan tunani na metafiziks guda biyu na farko na R. Descartes
answer_b: Suna tantance shawarar Cartesian game da ilmin lissafi da aka gabatar a cikin tunani na farko biyu na falsafar metaphysical na R. Descartes
answer_c: Sun gano gardamar Cartesian ta shakkar hyperbolic da aka gabatar a cikin tunani biyu na farko na metaphysical na R. Descartes
answer_d: Suna fahimtar matsayin Cartesian game da ƙwarewar azanci wanda aka gabatar a cikin Zuzzurfan Tunani na Metaphysics Biyu na Farko na R. Descartes

question: Malamin aji na goma sha biyu, a ƙarshen darasin Matasalolin Metaphysical da Epistemological, ya shirya tantance manufar koyo mai zuwa: 'Fahimtar bambance-bambancen epistemological tsakanin empiricism da rationalism.' Wace aiki ɗalibai za su iya yi domin malamin ya tantance manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Ƙirƙiri teburi tare da ra'ayoyin gama gari tsakanin matsayi biyun
answer_b: Shiri jerin manyan ra'ayoyin J. Locke da R. Descartes
answer_c: A bayyana a cikin zane tushen ilimi na gwajin-gani (empiricism) da tunani-tsantsa (rationalism)
answer_d: Shirya maganganu daban-daban gwargwadon nau'in ilimi a cewar D. Hume da J. Locke

question: Karanta yanayin da ke biye: A ƙarshen sashin "Hawawar Bourgeoisie", ɗaya daga cikin manufofin da malamin ya tantance shi ne fahimtar manyan halayen al'adun bourgeoisie a cikin ƙarni na 19. Saboda wannan, an umurci ɗalibai su shirya rahoto rubutacce. Waɗanne alamomi ne ya kamata a tantance don cimma manufar da aka ambata?
answer_a: Yana siffanta bourgeoisie a matsayin babban jigo na siyasa a cikin sauye-sauyen da aka gudanar a ƙarni na 19
answer_b: Yana bayyana salon rayuwar 'yan jari hujja, ra'ayinsu na daidaiku, da kuma manufar rayuwar sirri
answer_c: Yana nazarin tushe game da gudunmawar ajin 'yan jari-hujja da akidar sassauci ta su wajen bunƙasa da dimokuraɗiyyar tsarin gwamnati a lokacin ƙarni na 19
answer_d: Kwatanta manyan ayyukan tattalin arzikin da 'yan kasuwar karni na 19 suka samar, tare da nuna sauye-sauye da ci gaba idan aka kwatanta da na zamani na yanzu

question: Malamar na so ta tantancewa ta hanyar aikin rubutu ko ɗalibanta sun fahimci illolin ƙarshen Yaƙin Cacar Baki. Wace ce daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan da aka nema za ta tantance wannan manufa?
answer_a: Siffanta sauye-sauyen siyasa da Glasnost ta gabatar a Tarayyar Soviet a matsayin daya daga cikin abubuwan da suka haifar da ƙarshen Yaƙin Cacar Baki
answer_b: Bayyana rawar da Reagan da Gorbachev suka taka wajen kawo karshen Yakin Cacar Baki
answer_c: A ambata kamanni guda ɗaya da bambanci guda ɗaya tsakanin tsare-tsare biyu na nazarin tarihi dangane da ƙarshen Yaƙin Cacar Baki
answer_d: Bayyana yadda rarrabuwar ikon siyasar ƙasa da ƙasa ta kasance bayan ƙarshen Yaƙin Cacar Baki

question: Malamar za ta fara aiki a kan sashen 'Samfuran tattalin arziki da tasirinsu a kan yankin', da manufar sa ɗalibanta na makarantar sakandare su tantance canje-canjen da sararin ƙasa ya samu sakamakon dangantaka tsakanin matakai na tattalin arziki, yawan jama'a, da na sararin yanki. Saboda haka, ta yanke shawarar fara darasin ta hanyar tuna ma'anar kalmar sararin ƙasa, ta hanyar zaman tunani na rukuni. A cikin amsoshin da ɗaliban suka bayar, waɗanda suka sifanta sararin ƙasar keɓantacce daga ɓangaren ta na zahiri ko na halitta su suka fi rinjaye, suna danganta shi da siffar dawwama a matsakaici da dogon lokaci. Idan aka yi la'akari da ƙa'idodin koyarwa waɗanda ke jagorantar koyarwar ilimin ƙasa, wace ɗaya ce ke da matuƙar mahimmanci a yi aiki a kai don faɗaɗa tunanin sarari da wannan rukunin ɗaliban ke da shi?
answer_a: Haɗi
answer_b: Wuri
answer_c: Dogara ga juna
answer_d: Sillamanta

question: A cikin wani darasi na sashin 'Ginin Jihohin Ƙasashe a Turai da Amurka' an yi wannan tattaunawa kamar haka: Malam: Wa zai iya bayyana bambancin da ke tsakanin Jiha da Al'umma? Dalibai na 1: Al'umma ba ta ko da yaushe ta ƙunshi Jiha, kuma Al'umma na iya kasancewa a rabu a cikin Jihohi fiye da ɗaya. Dalibai na 2: Yaya? Ban fahimci abin da ta faɗa ba. Daga nan, Malamin ya yanke shawara cewa darasi na gaba zai fara ne da gabatar da wani kayan aiki na koyarwa wanda zai misalta amsar dalibai na ɗaya. A cikin wane zaɓi aka gabatar da aikin da ya fi bayyana kai tsaye alaƙar da ke tsakanin ma'anonin Jiha da Al'umma?
answer_a: Lura da taswirar da ke gaba kuma ka bayyana zahirin yanayin sararin samaniyar da ta wakilta
answer_b: Karanta taswirar ra'ayi mai biyo baya kuma kwatanta ta da ra'ayin ƙasa
answer_c: Ku lura da wannan fasto sannan ku bayyana da bakinku saƙon da yake ƙunshe da shi
answer_d: Karanta ma'anonin nan kuma kwatanta ra'ayoyin duka biyu

question: Wace daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ce za ta ba ɗaliban firamare na aji na biyu damar nuna fahimtar su game da ra'ayoyin kiwo-gama-kai (nomadism) da zama-daidai (sedentism) dangane da Chonos, wata ƙungiyar mutane a ƙasar Chile?
answer_a: Kwatanta kwale-kwalen da Chonos suka ƙirƙira don tafiyar ruwa
answer_b: Nemo Chonos a taswirar zahiri ta Chile
answer_c: Bayyana yadda Chonos suka sami abincinsu
answer_d:
Ku zana wakilan Chonos a cikin yanayin ƙasarsu na musamman
Ku zana wakilan Chonos a cikin yanayin ƙasarsu na musamman

question: Malamin ajin firamare, a cikin wani ajin da aka sa gaba don "Bayyana halayyar yanayin ƙasar wayewar Rome," ya tambayi ɗalibai su rubuta rahoton wata tafiya ta wani yanki na tsibirin Italiya, inda dole ne su fito da siffofin ƙasa da shimfiɗar wuraren da suka ziyarta, ta amfani da kalmomin ilimin ƙasa da suka koya. Don gudanar da aikin, ɗaliban, tare da taimakon malamin, sun kayyade hanyar tafiyar kuma sun zana ta a kan taswira, suna zaɓar biranen Rome da za su bi ta, ta hanyar amfani da bayanai daga tushe daban-daban don tabbatar da halayyar yanki na kowane wuri. Wanne daga cikin alamomin da ke gaba ya dace a yi amfani da shi don auna aikin ɗaliban dangane da manufar aikin da aka gudanar?
answer_a: Sun ambaci sunayen yankunan da wayewar Romawa ta samo asali daidai
answer_b: Suna gano manyan ci gaban da wayewar Rumawa ta samu tare da tsarin tafiyarsu da aka tsara
answer_c: Suna bayyana manyan siffofin da suka ƙunshi yanayin ƙasar hanyar da aka zana
answer_d: Suna bambanta al'adu daga yankunan ƙasa daban-daban inda wayewar Roman ta haɓaka.

question: Mai ba da ilimi yana da niyyar magance manufar koyo mai zuwa ta Jigon Muhallin Al'adu da Zamantakewa: 'Fahimtar matsayin da membobin iyalansu da al'ummar su ke takawa da kuma gudummawar da suke bayarwa ga jin daɗin rayuwar jama'a.' Wace irin gogewa ce ta fi dacewa don cika wannan manufar koyo?
answer_a: Ku yi tafiya ta kasuwar buɗeɗɗiya mafi kusa kuma ku umurci yara su sayi 'ya'yan itatuwa da kayan lambu yayin da suke yawo babu shakka
answer_b: Shirya ziyarar wani babba wanda zai ba da labarin yadda unguwar ta kafu da kuma yadda ta canza tsawon lokaci
answer_c: Ku ziyarci shagunan gida kuma ku sa yara su yi hira da mutanen da ke aiki a wurin, ta amfani da tambayoyi da aka shirya
answer_d: Ku yi rangadi a kusa da harabar ginin, kuma a wasu wurare, ku nemi yara su zana mutanen da suka fi jan hankalinsu

question: Malami, yayin da yake ɗakin hutun malamai yana tsara darasin “Rikicin Duniya Biyu,” ya karɓi shawara daga abokin aiki don haɗa da wani aiki wanda ya yi masa aiki mai kyau a shekarar da ta gabata don ƙarfafa aiki da majiyoyi. Ayyatar da aka ba da shawara ita ce: 1. Karanta rubutu na gaba: Castile ta ci masarautar Granada, kagara ta ƙarshe ta Musulunci a yankin, tare da goyon bayan Aragonese, kuma tana cikin wani lokaci na ƙarfin faɗaɗa, kamar yadda wannan nasarar sake cin nasara ta tabbatar. Yaƙe-yaƙe na dogon yaƙin da aka yi da Granada sun yi aiki, a tsakanin wasu abubuwa, don inganta dabarun soji har ma da gabatar da sababbin abubuwa masu muhimmanci a cikinsu. Bugu da ƙari, fasahar kewayawa ta inganta sosai a duk tsawon ƙarnin sha biyar, kuma Castile ta sami damar zama, a lokacin Trastámara, ainihin ƙarfin ruwa da kasuwanci a hanyoyin Atlantika da na Bahar Rum. Spain daga ƙarnin sha uku zuwa sha biyar: Sauye-sauye na Ƙarshen Tsarin Feudalism, Francisco Javier Fernández 2. Bayyana, bisa ga rubutun, wane yanayi na siyasa, tattalin arziki, da fasaha a Spain suka goyi bayan faɗaɗawa. Idan aka yi la’akari da cewa zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba su ne ƙwarewar bincike da aiki da majiyoyi da aka tsara a shirin malamin, wanne ne daga cikinsu ayyatar da aka ba da shawara za ta fi ƙarfafawa?
answer_a: Ƙirƙiri ka'idoji bisa ga hujjoji
answer_b: Gano fassarar tarihi na marubucin
answer_c: Gane asalin manufar tushen
answer_d: Kafa darajar bayanan da aka bayar

question: Malam/Malama, don sashin nan na “'Yancin Kai na Chile”, yana/tana ci gaba da tsara shirin nan: Manufar Koyo: Bayyana yadda aka ci gaba da aiwatar da 'yancin kai na Chile, la'akari da waɗanda suka taka rawa da rukunonin da suka fuskanci juna, muhimman maza da mata, ci gaba da koma bayan batun kishin ƙasa, da wasu muhimman abubuwan da suka faru. Manufar Ajin: Bambance matsayin 'yan kishin ƙasa da masu goyon bayan sarauta dangane da tsarin neman 'yanci. Ƙwarewar tunani da za a inganta: Tunani mai zurfi. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da aka lissafa zai yi daidai da manufofin ajin kuma za a iya haɗa shi cikin shirin?
answer_a: Cika mai tsarawa mai hoto da matakan Samun 'Yancin Kai
answer_b: Gina mujallar bango tare da bayanin jarumai na 'Yancin Kai
answer_c: Ƙirƙiri memes uku waɗanda ke nuna ra'ayoyin masu ruwa da tsaki daban-daban a cikin tsarin samun 'yancin kai
answer_d: Yi bidiyo na tsawon minti biyu da zai sake nuna ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da suka faru a lokacin samun 'yancin kai

question: A farkon sashin nan mai taken "Rushewar dimokuradiyya da lokacin mulkin kama-karya", wata malama ta bukaci ɗalibanta na aji shida su yi aiki a rukuni don kammala jigon lokaci tare da manyan abubuwan da suka ji waɗanda suka tsara tarihin ƙasar Chile daga 1970 zuwa 1990. Yayin da take lura da aikin, sai ta lura cewa ɗaya daga cikin ɗaliban yana matuƙar dagewa wajen tambayar sauran abokan karatunsa: "To, amma fa, wa ya jawo juyin mulkin sojoji?" Idan aka yi la'akari da tambayar ɗalibin, wace matsala ce a cikin koyon matakan tarihi za a iya hangowa?
answer_a: Iyakancewar hangen nesa ga bayanan da suka maida hankali kan al'amuran ɗan gajeren lokaci
answer_b: Takaita bincike dalilai daga mahangar halin yanzu
answer_c: Rasinan ikon tantance bayanan tarihi fiye da fagen siyasa
answer_d: Rashin sanin yawaitar dalilan da ke tattare da abubuwan tarihi

question: Malami a aji na 7, a cikin sashin "Wayewar garuruwan da suka ba da gudummawa ga samar da al'adar Yamma," ya tsara wani darasi da nufin siffanta Tekun Bahar Rum a matsayin wani wuri na zirga-zirga da musaya, da manufar bunkasa fasahar tunanin yanayin kasa, wanda ke da alaƙa da fahimtar rabuwar wuri da tsare-tsare waɗanda ke haɗe da mu'amalar yankuna. Bisa la'akari da tsarin darasin, wace daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ya kamata a gabatar don tantance ko ɗaliban sun cimma nasarar koyo da ake tsammani?
answer_a: Bayyana wuri da halayen Tekun Bahar Rum, ta amfani da taswirar siyasa ta yanzu
answer_b: Bayyana hanyoyin sadarwa da ke kewaye da Tekun Bahar Rum, ta amfani da taswirar tarihi
answer_c: Yi bayanin siffofin ƙasa daban-daban na yankin Mediterranean ta amfani da taswirar zahiri
answer_d: Bayyana muhimman fannoni na yanayin ƙasa na Tekun Bahar Rum ta hanyar ƙirƙirar taswirar tunani

question: Wata malama/malami na tsara darasi don sashen "Bambancin Yanayin Ƙasa na Chile: manyan siffofin jiki da albarkatun yankuna daban-daban na halitta na ƙasar", da nufin bai wa ɗalibansu na aji na 5 damar siffanta manyan yankuna na halitta na Chile da yanayinsu, suna la'akari da matattararsu ta yanki. Don haka, suna buƙatar tsara wani aiki na ƙarshe wanda zai ba su damar tabbatar da ko an cimma manufar. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan zai dace don auna manufar da aka gabatar don wannan darasin?
answer_a: Ku ƙirƙiri taswirar yankunan yanayi na Chile, ta amfani da alamomin da aka saba amfani da su
answer_b: Kwatanta yankuna na yanayi na Chile ta amfani da hotuna da taswiro daban-daban
answer_c: Gano sanannun wuraren yawon bude ido na kowane yanki na Chile ta amfani da Tsarin Kwatance na Wuri
answer_d: Nemo a kan taswira yankunan halitta na Chile da ka ziyarta tare da iyalinka, kuma ka bayyana su

question: Wata malama, a cikin sashin “Tsarin siyasa na Chile”, tana shirin wata darasi inda za ta yi aiki a kan ka’idar wakilci kuma za ta ba da wasu misalai na mukaman da aka zaba ta hanyar kuri’ar jama’a, da nufin cewa ɗalibanta na aji na 6 ko na 7 su fahimci “Muhimmancin zaɓen jama’a ga tsarin dimokuraɗiyya na Jihar Chile”. Idan aka yi la'akari da manufar darasin, wane ne daga cikin waɗannan alamomin ya dace don tantance ɗaliban a ƙarshen wannan darasin?
answer_a: Suna gano wane ne hukumomin siyasa da aka zaɓa ta hanyar jefa ƙuri'a don wakiltar ƴan ƙasa
answer_b: Suna bayyana muhimmancin zaɓaɓɓun hukumomi don yanke shawara na amfanin jama'a
answer_c: Sun bayyana manyan ayyukan hukumomin da ke wakiltar ƴan ƙasa bayan kammala tsarin zaɓe
answer_d: Suna nuna misalan nau'o'in shiga harkokin dimokuradiyya daban-daban da ke faruwa a cikin al'umma da kuma a cikin muhallinsu na kusa

question: Wani malami, yayin da yake gabatar da manufofin ɗabi'a da halaye, ya yi nuni da cewa abin da ke da kyau ga wasu ba lallai ba ne ya zama mai kyau ga wasu. Dangane da wannan, wani ɗalibi ya yi sharhi: “Waɗannan al'amura ne na ra'ayi kuma a ƙarshe komai abu ne na ra'ayi, wanda shi ya sa wasu abubuwa suke daidai ga wasu kuma ba ga wasu ba.” Wace matsala za a iya ganewa a cikin sharhin ɗalibin?
answer_a: Fahimtar ma'anar ra'ayin son rai kamar dai ɗabi'ar dangantaka ce kawai ta gaskiya da muke fada a cikinta
answer_b: Ragegowa da da'awowin sanin da'awowin hukunce-hukuncen ɗabi'a bisa dalilin ra'ayoyin mutane masu yawa daban-daban
answer_c: Ganin yanayin da mutum ke kallon abu a matsayin wanda zai fara haifar da wani irin ɗabi'a na musamman
answer_d: Gane cewa dangantakar ra'ayin ɗabi'a sakamakon halin mutum ne

question: Malama tana koyarwa a aji na ilimin ɗabi'a kan ma'anar nagartar Aristotelian. Ta tambayi dalibanta su ba da misalan ayyuka ko yanayin da nagarta ke bayyana. Wata ɗaliba ta bayyana cewa "wanda ya yi karatu mai yawa yana da nagarta kamar wanda ya yi wasannin motsa jiki mai yawa." Wane irin sa hannun malamar nan ne zai bai wa ɗalibar damar sake nazarin kalaman ta don ta ci gaba zuwa ga ingantacciyar fahimtar nagartar Aristotelian?
answer_a: Malamin yana tunatar da ɗalibin menene manyan halaye na kirki suke
answer_b: Malami ya tambayi ɗalibar ta bayyana abin da ta fahimta game da matsakaicin zinare
answer_c: Malamin yana jagorantar ɗalibin ya tuna cewa nufin ɗan adam yana karkata zuwa ga alheri
answer_d: Malam ya tambayi ɗalibin ya yi la’akari kan ko ’yan wasa suna da basirar halitta don yin wasan da suke so.

question: Malamar makarantar sakandare tana son ɗalibanta su iya banbance tsakanin ɗabi'a mai dogaro da kai da ɗabi'a mai dogaro da waje a cikin tsarin ɗabi'a daban-daban. Wane aiki ne zai fi dacewa ga ɗalibanta don su cimma manufar koyon da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Malamin ya zana jadawali a kan allo tare da manyan ra'ayoyin tsarin ɗabi'a na wanzuwa na Sartre da tsarin Kant
answer_b: Malami ya tsara kuma ya bayyana wa ɗalibai taswirar ra'ayoyi wadda ta haɗa da ra'ayoyin ɗa'a na Kantiyanci da na Hedonisanci, bisa tushen asali ko wajibcin ka'idoji ga ɗaiɗaikun mutane.
answer_c: Malamin ya umurci ɗalibai da su rubuta taƙaitaccen bayani da ke ɗauke da ainihin ra'ayoyin tsare-tsaren ɗa'a na Aristotle da Kant, tare da la'akari da tushen asalin ƙa'idodi ga mutum
answer_d: Malamar, tare da ɗalibanta, sun gina jadawalin kwatance bisa tushen manufofin da tsarin ɗabi'a da Hedonists da Stoics suka gabatar suke bi

question: Wani malami ya tsara wata aiki a shekara ta huɗu ta makarantar sakandare don cimma wannan manufa ta koyo: “Tattara ra'ayoyi daban-daban game da wata matsala ta zamantakewar ɗabi’a ta yanzu.” Matsalar da malamin ya tattauna da ɗaliban ita ce yadda za a bayyana iyakokin tsakanin jama'a da na sirri ta mahangar Arendt da sauran matakai na falsafa, haɗa su da amfani da fasahohin zamani na yau. A ƙarshen aikin, an ba da shawarar a auna nasarar koyo na ɗaliban. Wane aiki na ɗalibai ne daga cikin masu zuwa ya fi nuna cewa an cimma wannan manufa ta koyo?
answer_a: Suna gano hanyoyi daban-daban na falsafa da waɗanda ba na falsafa ba don ayyana iyakokin jama'a da na kashin kai
answer_b: Suna gane hujjojin da ke bayyana matsayinsu na kashin kai game da jama'a da sirri a yau, yayin da suke la'akari da tushen falsafar da aka yi amfani da su a cikin aji.
answer_c: Suna kwatanta hujjojinsu da na ɗalibin ajinsu game da iyakokin jama'a da na keɓaɓɓu a cikin amfani da kafofin sada zumunta, la'akari da nassosin falsafar da aka yi amfani da su a cikin aji
answer_d: Suna gina muhawara game da ka'idojin sirri a kan kafofin sada zumunta, ta amfani da ra'ayoyi daga masana falsafa na gargajiya, na zamani, ko na yau da kullum

question: A cikin yanayin kimantawa, wani malami ya umurci ɗalibansa su yi nazari kan tsarin dokokin tunani mai kyau wanda Descartes ya gabatar a cikin "Jawabi Kan Hanyar." Wanne daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan da ke gaba shi ne mai nuna kimantawa da ya dace don aikin da aka ƙayyade kuma ya yi daidai da koyon da ake tsammani?
answer_a: Suna ba da hujjar matsayin matakan ka'idodin hanyar
answer_b: Suna gano asalin dalilin kowace ɗaya daga cikin dokokin
answer_c: Suna gane kowanne daga cikin ƙa'idojin da ke cikin hanyar Cartesian
answer_d: Suna bayyana bambance-bambance tsakanin kowace ɗaya daga cikin dokokin tunani mai kyau

question:
Malamin makarantar sakandare, a yayin da yake shirya darasin "Chile a tsakiyar karni na 20", ya yanke shawarar amfani da hanyar warware matsaloli (problematization) a matsayin dabarar tantance ilimi. Bayan ya nuna wasu hotunan tarihi game da ƙuncin rayuwar mazaunan birni, malamin ya jefa wa ɗalibai tambaya mai zuwa: "Idan, tun daga shekarun 1930, gwamnatoci suka tallafa wa tsarin jin daɗin jama'a don rage rashin daidaiton zamantakewa, ta yaya za a iya bayyana fitowar 'yan ta'adda da ƙuncin rayuwa a titunan Santiago?"
Wace daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ce za a iya tantancewa ta hanyar wannan aikin da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Suna kwatanta bambance-bambancen haƙiƙanin zamantakewa daban-daban da ke wanzuwa a birane a tsakiyar ƙarni na 20
answer_b: Sun bayyana wurare daban-daban inda unguwannin ƙauyukan marasa galihu suka taso a tsakiyar ƙarni na 20
answer_c: Sun danganta tasirin manufofin gwamnati da ci gaban birnin a rabin farko na ƙarni na 20
answer_d: Suna bayyana ka'idojin Jihar Walwala da kuma dalilan kafa ta a rabin farko na karni na 20

question: Malami ya gaya wa ɗalibansa na shekara ta 3 na sakandare cewa yayin da suke aikin rukunin darasi mai taken "Rushewar Dimokiraɗiyya," za a yi aiki a rukuni kan manufa kamar haka: "A yi nazarin rushewar dimokiraɗiyya daga mahangar dalilai masu yawa." Don haka, ya ba su shawarar su nemi bayanai game da wannan lokaci a cikin hanyoyi daban-daban. Daga nan, ya bayyana cewa bisa ga waɗannan bayanai, a rukuni, za su raba abin da suka bincika tare da sauran ajin. Ɗaya daga cikin rukunonin ya tambayi malamin ko zai dace su yi gabatarwarsu da jirgin lokaci (timeline) na shekarun 1970-1973, tare da nuna muhimman abubuwan tarihi daban-daban. Malamin, bayan ya saurari su, ya gayyace su su nemo wata sabuwar hanyar gabatarwa, saboda aikin da suka gabatar ba zai ba su damar cimma manufar koyo da aka zaɓa ba. Me ya sa amfani da jirgin lokaci bai dace ba dangane da manufar koyo da aka gabatar wa ɗaliban?
answer_a: Don shī yana goyon bayan bincike ne daga mahangar tsari na lokaci, maimakon daga mahangogi daban-daban
answer_b: Saboda yana bambanta abubuwan tarihi, maimakon ya kafa tsarin matsayi bisa ga muhimmancinsu
answer_c: Saboda yana takaita nazarin ga kallon abubuwan da suka faru a jere, maimakon fahimtar tafiyar tarihin
answer_d: Domin yana sauƙaƙa jeranta abubuwan da suka faru, maimakon rarraba su gwargwadon fannoni daban-daban da ke cikin tsarin tarihi

question: Dalibai na aji na 3 dole su wakilci tafarkin tarihi na Zamanin Karshe bisa ga ka'idodin lokaci waɗanda masanin tarihi Eric Hobsbawm ya ayyana, ta hanyar gina jadawalin lokaci. Domin cimma wannan aiki, malamin ya ba da umarni mai zuwa: 'Fitar da ɓangaren da ke wakiltar "ƙarnin 19 mai tsawo" da kuma ɓangaren da ya dace da "ƙarnin 20 mai gajarta".' Sai dai, yayin da aka duba amsoshin, yawanci ba su yi daidai ba, kamar yadda aka gani a misali mai zuwa: Waɗanne ra'ayoyi ne ya zama dole a kafa su a cikin ɗalibai domin su cimma manufar da aikin ya gabatar?
answer_a: Matakin cigaba da yanayi ko haɗuwa
answer_b: Ci gaba da canji
answer_c: Lokaci na tarihi da lokaci na tsari (ko lissafi) na shekaru
answer_d: Tarihi da sakamako

question: A ƙarshen darasi kan ‘Yadda Kasuwa Ke Aiki,’ malami ya gudanar da kimantawa ta gano fahimta don sanin ko ɗalibansa sun fahimci dalilan da ke haifar da canji a buƙatar wani abu. Don haka, malamin ya nemi su zaɓi daga misalai daban-daban, aikace-aikacen wannan yanayi a cikin hali na rayuwa na gaske. Wanne daga cikin misalan nan ne ya dace da aikin ɗalibin da ya yi daidai da nasarar koyo da malamin ke tsammani?
answer_a: José: Kimanin shekaru biyu da suka wuce, ina sayen cakulan mai madara a shagon makarantar, amma tun da doka ta canza, yanzu dole in saye su a waje kuma in kawo su a cikin jakata
answer_b: Claudia: Karshen makon da ya wuce, mun je sinima tare da wasu abokai, amma tun da mun iso a makare, ba mu sami tikiti ba, sai muka yanke shawarar mu kashe kuɗin a kan piza da sanwic
answer_c: Jacqueline: A lokacin hutun bazara, mun shirya kuma muka kama fili don yin wasan ƙwallon kafa sau ɗaya a mako, don haka ina buƙatar samun pesos 1,200 a mako.
answer_d: Ignacio: Har zuwa bara, na kashe kudin alawus dina wajen sitikokin albam, amma yanzu da yake ba na son albam din kuma, ina ajiye kudin nan don in kashe shi a wani abu dabam

question: A mahallin sashin Sassa da yanayin aiki na tsarin tattalin arziki da kuɗi, malami zai yi nazari tare da ɗalibansa na aji na farko na makarantar sakandare kan yadda kasuwa ke aiki ta mahangar kayyade farashi. Saboda haka, sun yanke shawarar fara darasin da manufar sassauci da kuma wasu misalai. La'akari da mahallin da aka ambata, wane ilimin gaba ya kamata ɗaliban su mallaka don fahimtar manufar farko?
answer_a: Ƙa'idar karanci
answer_b: Dokar buƙata
answer_c: Tunanin hauhawar farashi
answer_d: Dabara ta shigarwa

question: Wani malami, bayan ya yi aiki a kan darasin "Tsarin Mulkin Doka," yana fayyace irin aikin da zai ba shi damar gane ko dalibansa na ajin hudu na sakandare sun iya fahimtar ka’idojin ginshiki na mulkin doka. Wane ne daga cikin ayyukan da ke biyo baya zai ba da damar tattara shaida don tantance cimma burin?
answer_a: Yana bayyana, ta amfani da wata majiya, aikin jihar a wajen kiyaye cikakken iko na yanki
answer_b: Yana nuna da wani labari cewa wata hukuma ta jiha tana bayar da lissafin ayyukanta
answer_c: Dokoki da ke bayyana alhakin jihar na kiyaye moriyar jama'a baki ɗaya
answer_d: Bambance-bambance a kan mahimmancin shiga zabe a cikin kafa gwamnati

question: Malamar aji na biyu tana aiki kan wayewar Girka da Rum tare da ɗalibanta kuma, a matsayin wani ɓangare na ayyukan ajin, ta raba ajin zuwa ƙungiyoyi, tana ba kowace ƙungiya kati wanda ke nuni ga wani muhimmumin abu mai wakiltar waɗannan al'adu, kamar: gidan wasan kwaikwayo, doka, gine-gine da fasaha, tatsuniya, falsafa, harshe, da sauransu. Kowace ƙungiya dole ne ta binciki jigin da aka ba su ta hanyar amfani da hanyoyin samun bayanai da malamar ta bayar kuma su nuna waɗanne ɓangarori na shi ne za a iya gane su a cikin abubuwan zamani kuma waɗanne ne ba za a iya ba. A kan wane ra'ayi na ilimin koyarwa na tarihi ne malamar za ta mai da hankali kan wannan aiki tare da ɗalibanta?
answer_a: Dawwama
answer_b: Shaidararriyar magana
answer_c: Juyin halitta da ci gaba
answer_d: Ci gaba da canji

question: Wani malami na aji na uku yana aiki tare da ɗalibai kan fannoni daban-daban na rayuwar yau da kullum ta tsoffin Girkawa. Lokacin da ake tattauna tsarin zamantakewa na al’ummar nan ta gargajiya, wata ɗaliba ta ce: “Girkawa mugaye ne.” Malamin ya tambaye ta me ya sa ta faɗi haka, sai ɗalibar ta amsa: “Domin suna da bayi.” Wane kuskure a cikin bincike na tarihi aka lura da shi a cikin kalaman ɗalibar?
answer_a: Tana tantance ɓangarorin al'adun Girka tana gabatar da nuna son kai na kabilanci
answer_b: Tana rikita tsarin matsayi na al'ummar Girka da na Rumawa
answer_c: Tana watsi da gadon al'adun Girka ga wayewar kai ta yanzu
answer_d: Tana daraja abubuwan al'ummar Girka ta hanyar amfani da rukunonin yanzu

question: Malamin aji na huɗu ya tara ɗalibai a ƙungiyoyi kuma ya ce su nemi bayanai a Intanet game da wata albarkatun ƙasa ta ƙasar Chile. Sa'an nan, ya nemi su tattauna muhimmancin wannan albarkatu, me zai faru idan ta ɓace, da kuma yadda za mu iya kiyaye ta a yau. A ƙarshe, kowace ƙungiya dole ne ta gabatar da ƙudurorinta ga ajin. Wace fasaha ce malamin yake da nufin bunƙasawa da farko ta hanyar wannan aiki da ke sama?
answer_a: Bincike
answer_b: Tunanin sarari
answer_c: Aiki da ma’ajiya
answer_d: Tunani mai zurfi

question:
Malami na aji na 3 yana so ya fara darasin Girka ta hanyar gabatar da ɗalibansa ga yanayin yanki inda wannan al'ada ta haɓaka da kuma nazarin tasirin da ta yi a kanta.
Wane irin taswira ne zai fi dacewa da manufar da malamin ya sa a gaba?
answer_a: Na jiki
answer_b: siyasa
answer_c: Tattalin arziki
answer_d: Yanayin-sauyin-gurbataccen-wuri

question: Malamar ajin yara za ta tantance manufar koyo mai zuwa a ƙarƙashin Manhajar Fahimtar Muhalli na Zamantakewa da Al'adu: “Binciken kayan aikin gida da abubuwan fasaha waɗanda suke wani ɓangare na rayuwar yau da kullum, kamar su: kwanoni, kwalaben roba, tsintsiya, cokali, wayoyi, da dai sauransu, ta hanyar amfani da su sannu a hankali a cikin yanayi na yau da kullum da wasanni.” Wane irin aiki ne ke nuna an cimma manufar koyon da aka faɗa?
answer_a: Ka yi ta fadin sunayen kayan fasaha kamar waya da agogo
answer_b: Yi amfani da kayan abinci na gida, kamar kofi da cokali, wajen yin wasan cin abinci
answer_c: Taɓa, sarrafa, da kuma fitarda sauti da kayan amfani na gida, kamar kwanuka da cokula
answer_d: Tsara kayan fasaha, kamar wayar hannu da wayar tarho, a wurin wasa da ya dace

question: A makarantar yara ƙanana, malamar za ta yi amfani da bayanan lura a matsayin kayan aiki don tantance koyon yara ƙanana bisa ga waɗannan alamomin na Ma’aunin Fahimtar Muhalli na Al'adu da Zamantakewa: Yana sanar da ayyukan da aka saba yi na al'ummar su. Yana bayyana yadda suke shiga cikin ayyukan da aka saba yi na al'ummar su. Wace irin ƙwarewar koyo ce za ta dace a lura da ita don tabbatar da nasarorin yaran dangane da alamomin da aka nuna?
answer_a: Akwai abubuwan da ke faruwa a cikin al'ummar ilimi
answer_b: Raba a cikin da'irar gaisuwa abin da suka yi a karshen mako
answer_c: Suka taru a ƙananan ƙungiyoyi, su yi kwaikwayon ayyukan yau da kullum da suke yi a gida
answer_d: A rukuni, tattauna rawar da 'yan uwa ke takawa a bukukuwa

question: Malamar aji uku a wani kimantawa na ci gaba ta lura cewa ko da yake ɗalibanta sun ƙware a fahimtar karatu, suna nuna matsala idan ya zo ga gabatarwa da kuma gardama a kan ra'ayoyinsu. Ganin wannan yanayi, malamar za ta inganta wani aiki wanda zai bai wa ɗalibai damar inganta ayyukansu. Wanne ne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa zai dace don cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Malamar ta ɓullo da littafin aiki, tare da ɗalibanta, mai ɗauke da nau'ikan hujjoji daban-daban, 'syllogisms', da ruɗu, tana mai musu bayanin yadda za su yi amfani da waɗannan abubuwan a rubutunsu.
answer_b: Malamin ya kafa ƙungiyoyin tattaunawa game da halayen falsafa a matsayin aikin tunani. Sa'an nan, dole ne ɗalibai su haɓaka tunani na kansu suna bada hujjar matsayinsu
answer_c: Malamin ya umarci ɗaliban su nemo wani labari mai jayayya a Intanet, sannan su ƙirƙiri gardama tasu ta kansu, bisa ga tsarin da aka gabatar a cikin littafin aikin da aka ba su.
answer_d: Malamin ya umarci ɗalibai su karanta “wasiƙa zuwa ga edita” kuma su taƙaita hujjojin da ke ciki. Bayan haka, dole ne su tsara nasu wasiƙar zuwa ga editan, suna kafa hujja kan ra'ayoyinsu na kansu.

question: Malamar aji na hudu na sakandare tana aiki a kan darasin Ɗabi’ar Jama’a. Manufar ajin ita ce ɗalibai su gane nau'o'in gwamnatoci daban-daban da aka gabatar tun zamanin da. Domin cimma hakan, ta ba su wasu sassa daga littafin Jamhuriya na Plato kuma ta nemi su ciro tare da bayyana nau’o’in gwamnatocin daban-daban da aka ambata. A lokacin aikin, wata ƙungiyar ɗalibai ta tattauna batu mai zuwa: idan har a yanzu ana ɗaukar dimokaraɗiyya a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin mafi kyawun tsarin mulki, me ya sa Plato ya bayyana ta a matsayin wani tsari na gwamnati mara kyau? Sai suka nemi malamarsu ta taimaka musu wajen warware matsalar. Bisa ga halin da ya gabata, wane sa baki ne daga malamar zai dace don shiryar da ɗaliban da warware tambayarsu?
answer_a: Tana ce musu su kwatanta gwamnatin kama-karya da ta dimokuradiyya, su tantance bambance-bambancen, sannan su yi amfani da rabe-raben Plato
answer_b: Ta ɗauki tambayar ɗalibai a matsayin dama don zurfafa shiga cikin ra'ayin Plato game da gwamnati cikakkiya, kuma ta kwatanta shi da nau'o'in gwamnati na yanzu
answer_c: Tana bayyana cewa gwamnatocin zamani ba za su iya dacewa da cikakken ma'anonin Plato na gwamnati ba saboda matuƙar sarƙaƙiyar tsarin na yanzu
answer_d: Ta nemi su sake karanta ma'anar dimokuradiyya ta Plato, sannan tare da su ta yi kwatanci tsakanin tsarin Plato da ma'anar dimokuradiyya ta yanzu

question: Malamar tana haɓaka darasin ɗabi'a (Ethics) a ajin sakandire na shekara ta huɗu, kuma a zama na gaba za ta magance manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Haɓaka ra'ayoyi na kashin kai game da ɗabi'ar ɗan Adam, tare da sake gina da kuma yin tambaya game da tushen wasu marubuta." A farkon ɓangaren darasin, malamar za ta bayyana wa ɗalibai ra'ayoyin ilimin ɗan Adam da Hobbes da Rousseau suka bayyana, kuma ta shirya wani aiki na gaba wanda zai ba ɗalibai damar shiga cikin wannan abun ciki da cimma manufar. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ne zai dace ga ɗalibai don magance manufar da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Dalibai sun yi gabatarwa ta baki a gaban abokan karatunsu, suna nuna misalai na rayuwar yau da kullum waɗanda ke nuna halin ɗan Adam a yanayin halitta, a cewar Hobbes da Rousseau.
answer_b: Yan makaranta suna yin wasan kwaikwayo na matsayi, inda dole su yanke shawara ko za su yi aiki bisa ga ra'ayin ilimin ɗan Adam na Hobbes ko na Rousseau domin cimma manufa
answer_c: Dalibai sun gudanar da tattaunawar teburin zagaye a kan batun fashin manyan kanti, suna jayayya bisa ga ka’idojin ilimin ɗan Adam na Hobbes da Rousseau
answer_d: Daliban sun gabatar da wani batu na da'a da ya shafi ɗaukar matsayi don bukatun ma'aikata ko na mai aiki, suna jayayya daga tushen ilimin ɗan adam na Hobbes da Rousseau

question: Malami yana nazarin sassa daban-daban daga littattafan falsafa tare da daliban aji na 12, waɗanda suka haɗa da Nietzsche da Sartre. Wani dalibi ya tambaya ko akwai wata alaƙa tsakanin maganar Nietzsche: “Allah ya mutu” da damuwar wanzuwa a cewar Sartre. Wane daga cikin amsoshin da ke gaba zai warware shakkar dalibin da harshe mai cikakken bayani da daidaiton ra'ayi?
answer_a: Haka ne, akwai alaƙa, domin Ka'idar Sartre ta samo asali daga abin da masana falsafa kamar Nietzsche suka taɓa nuna
answer_b: Eh, akwai alaƙa, domin dukkaninsu suna nuni ga ra'ayoyin falsafa masu ƙalubalantar abin da mutane suka daɗe suna ɗauka a matsayin daidai
answer_c: E, akwai dangantaka, tun da yake duka maganar nan ta “Allah ya mutu” da firgicin rayuwa suna nufin yanci ko ikon cin gashin kan ɗan adam na ɗabi’a dangane da Ubangiji, don yanke shawara da kuma yin aiki daidai ko kuskure.
answer_d: Eh, suna da alaƙa, tun da dukkan marubutan biyu suna tunani game da yanayin ɗan adam a gaban wanzuwa, da kuma cikakken rashi da rashin tabbas na jagorancin ɗabi'a don jagorantar ayyukan mutum, wanda ke zama mai dogaro ba tare da ka'idojin Ubangiji ko na ƙarshe ba.

question: Malami na aji huɗu a babbar sakandire ya yi bayanin sukan Kant game da fannonin ilimi, sa'annan ya umarci ɗalibansa su amsa wasu tambayoyi masu alaƙa a cikin littattafansu na rubutu. Bayan ya duba, ya gano cewa yawancin ajin sun ruɗa amsar Kant game da abin da ake sani da ra'ayin masu dogaro da hujjoji na zahiri (Empiricists). Wane aiki ne zai dace ɗalibai su yi don fahimta da rarrabe tunanin Kant?
answer_a: Dalibai sun taƙaita manyan halayen tunanin masu son kwarewa da na Kantian, suna lura da su a cikin litattafansu/littafansu na rubutu
answer_b: Dalibai sun gudanar da bincike a kan tunanin Kant da Locke, sannan kuma suka gabatar da manyan gudummawarsu.
answer_c: Dalibai za su yi nazarin kwatance na ra'ayoyin masu ra'ayin gogewa, masu ra'ayin hankali, da ra'ayoyin Kant, ta hanyar taswirar ra'ayi
answer_d: Ɗalibai sun ƙirƙiro kamus na kalmomin Kantiyanci, Empiristanci, da Rationalistanci

question: Wani malami na Sakandare na aji na 4 ya tsara buri ga ɗalibansa su tantance da fassara jumlar Nietzsche cewa "babu hujjoji, fassarori ne kawai", wanda saboda haka ya yanke shawarar yin amfani da kayan aiki na kafofin yaɗa labarai. Wane ne daga cikin ma'adanai masu zuwa ya dace don cimma wannan buri?
answer_a: Nuna labarin ƙarya da hujjojin da ke ɓata shi
answer_b: A nuna hotunan da aka gyara da na gaske na jaruman talabijin
answer_c: Fallasa labaran jarida guda biyu akan abu daya amma da dabarun edita mabambanta
answer_d: Nuna adadin so da rashin so a kan hoto game da wani labari

question:
Wani malami ya kimanta darasin Ilimin Sanin Gaskiya (Epistemology) a aji na uku na makarantar sakandare, musamman yana mai da hankali kan hujjojin Descartes game da Jigo (Substance). A cikin kimantawar, ya lura cewa wasu ɗalibai suna bayyana hujjoji game da ra'ayin cikar kamala da suke kama da waɗannan:

A cewar Descartes, idan dukan mutane suna da ra'ayin menene kamala, hakan ya faru ne saboda dukanmu mun taɓa samun gogewar wani abu kamili, kuma saboda haka an sanya wannan tunani a cikin zukatanmu. Kuma idan dukanmu mun san wani abu kamili, hakan ya faru ne saboda Allah ne ya halicci waɗannan abubuwan.

Dangane da hujjojin Descartes, wace irin matsalar fahimta a tsarin koyo ce za a iya samo ta daga wannan amsa?
answer_a: Dalibai sun kasa haɗa matsalar Descartes game da cikakken abu wanda ya samo asali daga ra'ayoyinmu
answer_b: Dalibai ba su fahimci hujjar Descartes ba game da ra’ayin kamala a matsayin tunanin haifaffe wanda ya samo asali daga hankali
answer_c: Dalibai ba su fayyace bayanan nasu yadda ya kamata ba, suna bayani cikin ruɗani game da Hujjar Cartesian a kan ra'ayin Allah wanda ya samo asali daga kamala
answer_d: Ɗalibai ba su tsara jerin hujjar yadda ya kamata ba don bayyana hujjar Descartes wacce ke fitar da wanzuwar Allah daga tunanin kamala

question: Malamin makarantar sakandare na aji hudu yana shirin yin bayanin ka’idar siyasar Plato, kuma saboda wannan yana bukatar ya duba ko ɗaliban suna da masaniyar da ake bukata a baya. Wane ra'ayi na Plato ne ɗalibai ke buƙatar sani don su fahimci yadda Plato ke ɗaukar Jiha da kyau?
answer_a: Irin rayuka
answer_b: Rikar ta ruhu da jiki ta Plato
answer_c: Ka'idar ra'ayoyi
answer_d: Tunanin kyawawan halayen siyasa

question:
Wani malami yana koyar da darasin Ilimin Sanin Asali (Epistemology) a aji na uku na sakandire tare da dalibansa, kuma a matsayin wani aiki don cimma manufar: "Fahimtar asalin ilimin ɗan Adam," sun ba da shawarar karantawa da fassara Zuzzurfan Tunani na Farko na Descartes.

Wanne ne daga cikin ilimin da suka rigaya suka samu ya zama wajibi dalibai su mallaka don cimma manufar darasin?
answer_a: Tunanin Ra'ayin Hankali da Ra'ayin Gwaninta
answer_b: Ma'anonin ilmin kimar abubuwa (axiology) da ilmin sanin gaskiya (epistemology)
answer_c: Rundunonin Tabula Rasa da kuma zuggagewa
answer_d: Ruhun dabba da mazgwon kwakwalwa

question: Malamin aji na 12, a sashin ilimin Ɗabi'a, zai yi aiki tare da ɗalibansa a kan ra'ayin dangantakar ɗabi'a ta Spinoza. Wane tunani ne na Spinoza yake da muhimmanci ɗaliban su mallaka don su fahimci dangantakar ɗabi'a tasa?
answer_a: Rayuwa mai kyau
answer_b: Tasiri na asali
answer_c: son rai na hankali
answer_d: Ƙwaƙwalwar motsin zuciya

question: Wani malami yana tantance ci gaban taswirorin kwatance, waɗanda ɗaliban ajin shekara ta 4 ta sakandare suka haɓaka a rukuni, game da shawarwarin falsafa na Descartes da Locke. Manufar aikin ita ce ɗalibai su fahimci kuma su kwatanta matsalar ilimin sanin gaskiya a cikin marubutan biyu. A cikin aiki ɗaya, an lura cewa ɗalibai sun gabatar da ra’ayoyin da suka dace da marubutan, amma ba a kafa kwatance a tsakaninsu ba. Wace shawara ce a cikin waɗannan masu zuwa ke ba da bayani game da yadda aka yi aikin kuma take shiryar da ɗalibai daidai don cimma manufar?
answer_a: Ra'ayoyin da aka gabatar sun dace kuma sun yi daidai, amma suna buƙatar rarraba mai zurfi don inganta aikinsu.
answer_b: Bayyanin kowane marubuci daidai ne. Rashin tsari ne a ciki bisa ga tambayoyi ko ra'ayoyin da suke gama gari, waɗanda suke da amsoshi da ma'anoni mabambanta, don a iya yin kwatankwacin da ya dace.
answer_c: Aiki ne mai kyau. Amma, don a inganta kwatancin, ya zama dole a daidaita shi da tsanaki sosai bisa ga ra’ayin falsafa na kowane marubuci
answer_d: Shirye-shiryen falsafa na kowane marubuci an gano su sosai. Yanzu, don yin kwatanci mafi dacewa, yana da mahimmanci a tsara ra'ayoyin tare da ƙarin daidaiton muhawara

question: Malami na makarantar sakandare, a cikin darasin Matsalolin Kasancewa, zai tantance wannan manufa mai zuwa: “Aiki da zurfin tunani da bincike kan ra’ayin Heidegger na wanzuwar da ba ta asali ba.” Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ayyuka ne zai dace don nuna nasarar koyo da ke da alaƙa da wannan manufa?
answer_a: Shirya tsarin sati-sati na ayyukan yau da kullum wanda ke nuna salon rayuwa na ƙarya
answer_b: Kirkiri taswirar tunani tare da dalilai uku da ke kai wa ga rayuwar rashin gaskiya
answer_c: Yi kwalej da tallace-tallacen jaridu da mujallu da ke nuna rayuwa ta bogi
answer_d: Rubuta shafin ra'ayi kan yadda tsarin al'ada ke taimakawa wajen samar da rayuwa maras gaskiya

question: Karanta yanayin nan mai zuwa: Wata malama tana aiki da ɗalibai na shekara ta biyu a makarantar sakandare a kan sashin darasin "Ƙarfafa Jihar da Dimokraɗiyyar Zamantakewa a Chile a Rabinsu na Farko na Ƙarni na 20". Domin tantance ko ɗalibai sun fahimci tsarin kafa Ƙungiyar Jama'a a Chile, sai ta ce su haɗu da abokan ajinsu biyar su zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin ƙungiyoyin siyasa na tsakiya-hagu waɗanda suka kasance a Chile a shekarar 1937 a matsayin batun (socialists, communists, radicals, da anarchists) kuma bisa ga tushen bayanan da aka yi aiki da su a darussan da suka gabata, su amsa tambaya mai zuwa: "Me ya sa ƙungiyar za ta shiga cikin Ƙungiyar Jama'a?". Sannan ta ce su yi kwaikwayon wani taro inda kowace ƙungiyar aiki za ta gabatar da dalilan da suka sa ƙungiyar siyasa za ta shiga ko ba za ta shiga Ƙungiyar Jama'a ba. Idan aka yi la'akari da kashi na biyu na aikin, wane irin wasan kwaikwayo ne za a iya tantance shi?
answer_a: Sun haɗa mahallin da Popular Front ɗin ta fito a ciki
answer_b: Sun bambance ra'ayoyin da suka tsara Gaban Jama'a
answer_c: Sun bayyana ƙa'idojin akida na Popular Front
answer_d: Suna bayyana dalilan kafa Jam'iyyar Hadin Gwiwa ta Jama'a (Popular Front)

question: Malami aji na biyu na makarantar sakandare, a cikin jigon darasi na Daga Duniya Mai Kuttura Biyu zuwa Duniya Gaba Ɗaya: Yaƙin Cacar Baki, yana da burin aiki a kan manufa mai zuwa: “Bambanta manyan sauye-sauye na siyasar ƙasa da ƙasa bayan ƙarewar Yaƙin Cacar Baki,” ƙarƙashin jaddadawar manhaja ta tunanin tarihi. Don yin haka, malamin ya samar wa ɗalibai taswirori biyu na Turai, ɗaya na shekarun 1960 ɗayan kuma na shekarar 2000, yana roƙon su da su bayyana kamanni uku da bambance-bambance uku a fannin siyasar ƙasa da ƙasa. Wane ɓangare na jaddadawar manhajar da aka gabatar ne aka fi mayar da hankali a kai a cikin aikin da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Tusar takamaiman matakai na tarihi a lokaci da wuri
answer_b: Nuna yanayin abin da ke faruwa na abubuwan tarihi a tsawon lokaci
answer_c: Kafa dangantaka tsakanin fannoni daban-daban da ma'aunan sararin samaniya na al'amuran ɗan adam
answer_d: Ka fahimci cewa tarihi gini ne na ɗan Adam da yake tasowa bisa ga lokaci da wuri

question: Wacce daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa ce za ta taimaka wa ɗaliban aji na 4 su fahimci bambanci tsakanin matsayi na dangi (relative) da matsayi na cikakken (absolute) na jiki a kan jirgi (plane) ko taswira?
answer_a: Ɗalibai ɗaiɗai za su yi alamar masarufai daidai da abubuwa daban-daban da aka zana a kan gidan masarufi, sa'an nan su bayyana wurin waɗannan abubuwan bisa ga waɗanda suke kusa da su. A ƙarshe, za su kwatanta wuraren biyu kuma su raba kudurorinsu.
answer_b: A rukuni biyu, ɗalibi guda ya zana abu a kan allon grid na coordinates, yana sanya shi bisa ga umarnin da ɗayan ya bayar. Sai su canza matsayinsu kuma su maimaita aikin. A ƙarshe, su kwatanta wuraren sannan su bayyana abin da suka gano.
answer_c: A biyu-biyu, ɗalibi guda ya ba wa ɗayan umarni ta amfani da ginshiƙin ma'auni don su kai ga teburin da aka nuna a cikin ɗakin. Sannan, sai su tabbatar ko wurin teburin a kan ginshiƙin ma'aunin ya dace da wurin teburin a zahiri kuma su raba sakamakonsu.
answer_d: Ɗalibai ɗai-ɗai suna bayyana hanyoyin isa wurare daban-daban bisa taswirar da aka zana a kan gidan layukan ƙidaya wadda ke ɗauke da furen kamfas, kana su kwatanta da tattauna bayanan nasu tare da ajin.

question: A cikin aji na 5, wata malamar tana aiki tare da ɗalibanta a kan manufar koyo mai zuwa: "Bincika, bayyanawa, da kuma gano bala’o’i na halitta da suke shafar yankin da suke ciki, kamar su girgizar ƙasa, tsunami, ambaliyar ruwa, zaizayar ƙasa, da fashewar dutsen wuta." Bugu da ƙari, an yi niyyar ƙarfafa ci gaban tunanin ƙasa, wato, ƙarfin lura da kuma gano alaƙoki masu yawa da aka kafa tsakanin mutane da muhalli, tare da haɓaka tsarin aiki na kare muhalli tsakanin ɗaliban. Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba ne zai iya haɓaka tunanin ƙasa kuma ya cimma manufar da aka gabatar?
answer_a: Dalībaj suna rarraba ire-iren haɗarurruka na dabi'a daban-daban da ke yankinsu, bisa ga yankin da suke shafa, suna tantance yanayin da suka fi kama da juna
answer_b: Dalibai suna yin taswirar yankinsu da ke nuna bala'o'i na dabi'a da suka faru a yankin nasu a 'yan shekarun nan.
answer_c: Ɗalibai za su bayyana wani haɗari na halitta da ya faru a yankinsu, suna bayyana musabbabinsa, tasirinsa ga al'umma, da kuma matakan da za a iya ɗauka don rage haɗarorin.
answer_d: Dalibai suna binciken wani hatsarin yanayi da ke yankinsu, suna bayyana irin hatsarin, manyan siffofin sa, da kuma sau nawa ya faru a cikin karni na baya

question: Wata malama tana nazarin tushen juyin mulkin 1973 tare da ɗalibanta na aji shida. Ɗaya daga cikinsu ya katse ta don yin tambaya kamar haka: “Malama, ban gane ba idan kika ce mana: 'Wannan yanayin ya kasance sanadin juyin mulkin ga wannan masanin tarihi, amma ba ga wancan ba.' To, shin Amurkawa sun taka rawa sosai a cikin juyin mulkin 1973? E ko a’a?” Wace kuskuren fahimta game da tarihi, a matsayin fanni, za a iya fahimta daga tsoma bakin ɗalibin?
answer_a: Rage tarihin zuwa tasirin manufofin ƙasashen waje
answer_b: Shigar da akidoji cikin labaran tarihi
answer_c: Ra'ayin tarihi a matsayin cikakken bayani na abin da ya faru a baya
answer_d: Fassarar dalili ɗaya game da abubuwan tarihi

question: Malamin aji na 7 zai tantance ko ɗalibansa sun “Bayyana canje-canjen da suka samo asali daga juyin juya halin zamanin dutse na Neolithic a cikin alaƙar ɗan Adam da muhalli ta hanyar nazarin madogara.” Wanne daga cikin ayyukan da ke gaba zai bai wa malamin damar tattara shaida na cimma manufar da aka nuna?
answer_a: Ku umarci ɗalibai su zaɓi kafofin yanar gizo ɗaya bayan ɗaya game da halayen zamanin Dutse na Ƙarshe (Neolithic) kuma su bayyana su
answer_b: Ku tambayi ɗalibai su yi aiki a biyu-biyu don nazarin wasu maɓuɓɓuga daban-daban game da juyin juya halin zamanin dutse, sannan su gabatar da muhimman ra'ayoyin kowace ɗaya daga cikinsu
answer_c: Ku umarci ɗalibai su yi aiki a rukuni biyu-biyu don su kammala jadawali game da bambance-bambance da kamance-kamance tsakanin majiyoyi guda biyu masu alaƙa da tsarin siyasa da zamantakewa da aka kafa a Zamanin Neolithic
answer_d: A umarci ɗalibai su rubuta ɗai-ɗai rubutun jayayya game da sauye-sauyen da ayyukan samarwa na Zamanin Dutse Na Ƙarshe suka kawo, bisa ga majiyoyi daban-daban

question: Malamin aji na 7 yana haɓaka darasin game da fitowar wayewar farko. A ɗaya daga cikin azuzuwan, an yi magana a kan manufar: “Fahimtar tsarin siyasar Masar ta dā.” Ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan da aka nema daga ɗalibai shine karanta wata majiya ta bayanai game da yadda aka tsara ikon siyasar Fir’auna a Masar, don daga baya su tantance daidai da manufar da aka gabatar. Wanne daga cikin ayyuka masu zuwa zai nuna cewa ɗalibai sun cimma wannan manufa?
answer_a: Suna bayyana tsarin haɗewar masarautun Misra, wanda ya ƙarfafa gwamnatin tsakiya
